name: duospace-app-update
description: Local Capacitor plugin: in-app APK update for sideloaded DuoSpace builds. Android only. Downloads through the system DownloadManager (Wi-Fi-only or Wi-Fi+cellular, resumable, survives app kill), verifies SHA-256 + package + version + signing certificate, then hands the APK to the system installer. iOS has no native implementation: OTA install there is an itms-services link opened by the JS layer.
author: DuoSpace

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && rollup -c rollup.config.mjs
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
